description: USE THIS to find the next public/bank holiday on or after a date (default today) — e.g. to find the next working day. Supports ~200 countries (ISO code, e.g. GB, US, ZA, DE); subdivision narrows to a region.

after.description: Find the next holiday on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD); default today.

country.description: ISO country code (default GB), e.g. GB, US, ZA, DE.

subdiv.description: Subdivision code (e.g. UK nation SCT/WLS/NIR, or a US state).

name: next_holiday
